title: Reported VOC classes
content:
Aldehydes: repeated human reports and a bounded host question.
Ketones: systemic fuel and fasting effects.
Hydrocarbons: physiology, ambient and material sources.
Alcohols: diet, exposure and oral sources.
Acids: microbial, luminal and systemic sources.
Other classes: heterogeneous chemistry and annotation.

title: Selected external anchor
content:
C4-C10 straight-chain saturated aldehydes:
butanal, pentanal, hexanal, heptanal,
octanal, nonanal and decanal.
Repeated reporting, limited tissue proximity, shared
chemistry and breath measurability; directions vary.

title: Two separate constructs
content:
G: PUFA-phospholipid substrate assembly
and enzymatic lipid-oxidation support.
H: heterogeneous oxidative aldehyde handling.
Keep G-buffer and H context programs separate.
No subtraction, reverse score or composite.

title: Human evidence architecture
content:
Independent paired bulk cohorts: central replication.
Donor-aware single-cell states and captured composition.
Paired ordinary protein abundance.
Same-patient RNA-protein bridge: exploratory,
shares patients with ordinary protein.

title: Competing sources
Claim ceiling
content:
Biochemical compatibility of predefined
molecular configurations only.
No direct VOC measurement, origin, activity, flux,
causality, transfer or classifier explanation.
Direct chemical and functional validation is needed.
